policies.using:
((candidate_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (jobs j
     JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = j.company_id)))
  WHERE ((j.id = applications.job_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: Users manage own job alert preferences
Public can view active job categories
Conversation participants send messages
policies.check:
((sender_id = auth.uid()) AND (((sender_id = candidate_id) AND (recipient_id = poster_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((applications a
     JOIN jobs j ON ((j.id = a.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = j.company_id)))
  WHERE ((a.id = job_messages.application_id) AND (a.job_id = job_messages.job_id) AND (a.candidate_id = job_messages.candidate_id) AND (job_messages.poster_id =
        CASE
            WHEN (j.poster_type = 'individual'::text) THEN j.posted_by_user_id
            ELSE c.owner_id
        END))))) OR ((sender_id = poster_id) AND (recipient_id = candidate_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((applications a
     JOIN jobs j ON ((j.id = a.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = j.company_id)))
  WHERE ((a.id = job_messages.application_id) AND (a.job_id = job_messages.job_id) AND (a.candidate_id = job_messages.candidate_id) AND (((j.poster_type = 'individual'::text) AND (j.posted_by_user_id = auth.uid())) OR (c.owner_id = auth.uid()))))))))
